title: GTA6 Soars to No. 1 on Netflix's Movie Chart
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is dominating Netflix's movie charts, with its 27-minute extended look hitting No. 1 in 87 countries.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Dominates Netflix Movie Charts Worldwide

When it comes to generating unprecedented global hype, few titles in entertainment history can rival Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster. According to a recent report by gaming media outlet Polygon, the anticipation for Grand Theft Auto 6 has now transcended traditional gaming spaces and officially conquered the streaming world.

The massive wave of attention centers around a 27-minute extended look at GTA6, which has been making major waves on Netflix. Instead of remaining confined to traditional gaming platforms or video-sharing sites, the extended footage surged through Netflix's movie charts, ultimately claiming the No. 1 spot in 87 countries. This remarkable crossover achievement highlights just how intensely the global audience is craving any and all official content related to the title.

## A Phenomenal Crossover Success for Gaming

It is rare for promotional video game material to infiltrate mainstream movie and streaming charts with such aggressive dominance. The 27-minute extended look has captivated millions of viewers worldwide, transforming a standard gaming showcase into a cross-platform cinematic event. For a gaming-related release to outpace traditional feature films across 87 different regions on a major streaming service speaks volumes about the cultural footprint of the franchise.

While fans continue to dissect every second of the footage for clues about the game's world and mechanics, this Netflix milestone proves that the momentum behind the title is entirely unmatched in modern entertainment.

## Editor's Take

Seeing GTA6 conquer Netflix's movie charts in 87 countries with a 27-minute extended look is nothing short of extraordinary. It proves that the excitement surrounding this game goes far beyond traditional gaming circles, turning into a massive global pop-culture phenomenon long before launch.
